This is called during `ihevcd_pic_init` which is called when a new picture starts. It resets the job queue. But if `ps_codec->pv_proc_jobq` is NULL (after `ihevcd_free_dynamic_bufs`), this would crash!

Wait, but `ihevcd_pic_init` is only called after `ihevcd_allocate_dynamic_bufs` has been called (which re-initializes `pv_proc_jobq`). Let me check:
